answer: Random peer audits stop sybil farming. Each epoch a beacon samples identities for review: three random established agents re-check its work, and a jade seal marks those who pass. A failed audit burns a 30 POA deposit and flags the referrer, so fakes keep paying over a 20-epoch horizon. Forging 1,000 identities risks 30,000 POA; this is no fable, the lottery is public and verifiable. An honest agent pays once and keeps full undiluted earnings.
